correctness.rationale: All nonzero nonnegative summable stationary vectors are strictly positive. Recurrence tails and their unique summable characteristic roots give an exact two-by-two refuge matching problem. Its positive solution yields the stated single algebraic eigenparameter; ℓ1 tail decay is equivalent to delta>delta2 and logistic mass requires lambda>a2. The single-refuge analog gives delta>mu|p-q|. The exact radical example and recurrence residuals are independently checked using a companion symbolic program; finite checks are not used as proof for infinite claims.

value.rationale: The bounded-background mutation–selection model exhibits a mathematically motivated contrast with confinement: selection islands can fail to localize due to directional drift. Two adjacent favorable types overcome that loss in an exact nonempty parameter interval where any single island fails irrespective of birth rate. Complete thresholds and normalized equilibrium give a reusable sharp viability boundary instead of a routine special-value computation.
